episode_summary: Gwen Snyder shares her approach to building a successful luxury real estate business without cold calling, focusing on relationship-building and exceptional client service. She emphasizes the importance of being referable by anticipating client needs and leveraging personal authenticity. The episode provides actionable strategies for agents to grow their business through referrals and effective follow-up.
